assessments.reasoning: In the retained Ada 2022 Reference Manual, §12.1 places the formal part before the package specification in a generic package declaration. The formal part begins with the generic keyword and permits zero formal parameter declarations. This establishes the declaration clause. Section 10.1 supplies the separate compilation clause.

Section 10.1 defines a library unit by separate compilation and includes packages among the possible library units. Its discussion of physical nesting limits the inference to packages with library-unit status. Together with §12.1, this supports both clauses without requiring a generic package declaration to occur at library level.

limitations: A generic formal part can contain zero generic formal parameter declarations.
A package can also be nested. This claim covers separate compilation only for packages that are library units.
